Headline results for run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20; window 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z, 3.314% of the time span).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc).
- Pumping context: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days (net extraction).
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED probability (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5; this is the LBNL/NCEDC-calibrated estimate):
  b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198,  P(M>=5.5) over observed volume = 5.236e-06,  P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719
  b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922,   P(M>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0002155, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809
  b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474,    P(M>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0006484, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection is counted as an event at/above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts):
  b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

Interpretation: the calibrated LBNL-catalogue probabilities for a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event are very small (1.2e-04 to 1.5e-02 per year depending on b), whereas the DAS-based number (0.07842/yr) is only an upper bound because the DAS magnitudes are uncalibrated and the detection count over-counts events; it should not be read as a calibrated hazard estimate.
